args.query: implement an LRU cache from scratch in Python without functools or any library, O(1) get and put

results.title: lru-cache TTL eviction and size limits
results.summary: Cache computed values with lru-cache, covering max entries, TTL expiry via fake timers, and getOrSet style populate helpers offline.

results.title: cache-manager memory store wrap and mset
results.summary: Create a cache-manager cache backed by Keyv Map storage, wrap loaders, and multi-set values offline.

results.title: TanStack Query Core fetch and cache
results.summary: Drive async data fetching with @tanstack/query-core QueryClient, covering staleTime, cache hits and invalidateQueries without React offline.

results.title: Jotai atoms with React 19, tested with Testing Library and isolated stores
results.summary: Jotai 3 primitive, derived, write-only and async atoms driving a React 19 todo UI with Suspense, tested in Vitest on happy-dom with @testing-library/react, user-event and a fresh createStore per test, plus store-only tests without React.

results.title: Preact components with Signals state, tested with Testing Library on jsdom
results.summary: A Preact 11 cart using @preact/signals signal and computed state plus a hooks-based async form, tested in Vitest on jsdom with @testing-library/preact and user-event, including re-render on signal change without new props.

results.title: Tiered cache: diskcache FanoutCache plus cachetools LRU
results.summary: A MutableMapping two-tier cache that promotes values from a sharded diskcache FanoutCache into a cachetools LRUCache, covering persistence, expiration and promotion gotchas with offline tests.

results.title: ioredis cache-aside with TTL, tested with ioredis-mock (Vitest)
results.summary: Cache-aside helper on ioredis with JSON values, TTLs, stampede-safe single flight and invalidation, tested offline with ioredis-mock in Vitest. Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because ioredis-mock 8 still peers on ioredis ^5, but the mock passes its tests against ioredis 6. vite is pinned so Vitest still resolves under legacy-peer-deps.

results.title: SolidJS signals, memos and resources, tested with Solid Testing Library
results.summary: SolidJS components using createSignal, createMemo, For, Show and createResource with Suspense, compiled by vite-plugin-solid and tested in Vitest on jsdom with @solidjs/testing-library and user-event.

results.title: Ink interactive CLI components tested with ink-testing-library
results.summary: Build an interactive Ink 8 (React) terminal checklist with useInput and a timer-driven countdown, and test frames, arrow-key and space input, submit callbacks and effects with ink-testing-library.

results.title: Valibot 1 pipes, transforms and branded outputs
results.summary: Build a Valibot 1 schema pipeline with trim, email, pipe transforms, brands and safeParse that returns typed output or issue paths, without a web framework.
